steps.title: A chain
steps.say: Java checks each condition top to bottom and runs the **first** one that's true. The rest are skipped.

steps.title: Order matters
steps.say: Swap the first two and `EMPTY` can never happen: 0 is already less than 50.

steps.title: Boundaries
steps.say: Test exactly at the edges: is 50 LOW or MEDIUM? `< 50` means 50 is MEDIUM. `<= 50` would make it LOW.

board.code:
batteryStatus(0)   // EMPTY
batteryStatus(49)  // LOW
batteryStatus(50)  // MEDIUM
batteryStatus(90)  // FULL

steps.title: Open Main.java
steps.say: Press **Ctrl+P**, type `Main` and press Enter. Quick Open finds any file by name, so you never have to dig through folders.
